Pulled straight from School details in Settings — fill a field in there first if it shows as not set.

Each back is mirrored so it lands behind its own front. Pages print front, back, front, back — choose Print on both sides in the print dialog. Do a one-sheet test first (Student Access → alignment test) to confirm your printer's turn direction. Students whose PIN was created in this session get their PIN on the back; the others get a return-address back.

In the print dialog, set Paper size to A4, Scale to 100% / Actual size (not "Fit to page"), and Margins to None — this keeps every card at true ID-card size for die-cutting.

Teacher Accounts

Subjects list

Signature gallery

Teachers

Backup & Restore

Everything lives only on this device — back it up regularly.

Export a backup

Saves a file with every student, payment and setting. Keep copies somewhere safe (email it to yourself, save to Drive, etc.) in case this device is lost or its browser data is cleared.

Export students as CSV

A plain spreadsheet file of every student and their balance — good for printing or opening in Excel.

Restore from a backup

Loading a backup file replaces everything currently in this ledger. Make sure that's what you want first.

Academic Records

Import assessment spreadsheets, generate and print report cards.

Importing reads the .xlsx file's data with a small library loaded from the internet — a one-time connection just for this step. Everything else in this app, including viewing and printing report cards afterward, works fully offline.

Term details

Just enter Term began and the Vacation date: the register counts every Monday–Friday from the first day to the last day (the vacation week included, so you can keep marking until the last day), minus the holidays above. Only fill "Attendance out of" if you want to fix the total yourself.

PINs

PINs stay visible here for you (the admin) so you can print slips or ID cards any time, or read one out if a parent forgets it. Students never see this list. Use Hide PINs when someone else can see your screen. PINs made before this update cannot be read back: press Make old PINs viewable once per class to give them new, viewable PINs.

Settings

Google Sheet health

Every detail the app keeps is shown as a column you can read and edit in Google Sheets. This check finds columns the app no longer uses. Before anything is removed its data is copied to a backup tab, so nothing useful is lost.

School details

          
Used on printed report cards and throughout the app.

          

          

          

          

          

          

            
Every student gets a permanent unique ID like PREFIX/YEAR/P1004 — e.g. GJMS/2026/P1004: the year of admission, the class they were admitted to (P1), and their number in that class (004). It never changes, even when they are promoted. Leave blank to auto-use your school name's initials. Changing the prefix only affects new IDs.

          

            
Teachers get IDs like GJMT/2026/TIDN07 (year added + their number). Leave blank to use your student prefix with a T at the end.

          

            
Students already numbered keep their ID unless you press this. Only use it before cards are handed out, or if you will reprint them.

Data Storage

          

          

            
            
            
          

          
To move to another device: copy this HTML file and your linked database file into the same folder on the other device, open the app there, go to Settings → Data Storage → Open an existing database file, and pick that file. From then on both devices can each stay linked to their own copy — but only one at a time should actually be in use, since they won't sync with each other automatically (see Backup & Restore for moving data between them).

        

        

          
Online Sync

          
Optional. Connects this device to a small free Google-hosted database, so two (or more) devices can stay in step — each keeps working fully offline, and quietly catches up with the other the moment it's back online. Requires a one-time setup in Google Sheets first (ask for the setup script and instructions if you haven't done this yet).

          

          

            

              

              

            

            
            

          

          

            

              
              
            

            
Connect another device

            
Emails the connection details to whoever opens this on the other device — keep this email private, since anyone with it can read and write your school's data.

            

              

              

            

            
            

          

          
Syncs automatically whenever this device has internet (every 45 seconds, and instantly when it reconnects): students (including photos and ID card numbers), the school logo, tuition/admission/feeding payments and billing, fee schedule, feeding rate, school details, academic settings, promotion path, teacher accounts, and Academic Records (scores, remarks, attendance, term history — each teacher's subject scores merge safely with everyone else's).

        

        

          
Start New Term (Tuition only)

          
Archives every tuition payment made so far under a label you choose, then clears the live payment log for a fresh term. Fee Schedule amounts stay exactly as they are — nothing to re-enter. Any student still owing money has that exact balance carried forward as their opening balance for the new term. Admission Fee and Feeding Fee are separate running tabs and are not touched by this.

          

          
          

        

        

          
Term History

          
Look back at any term you've closed — its payment log and each student's balance at the time.

          

          

        

        

          
Promotion Path

          
List every class in order, earliest first, one per line — exactly matching how classes are spelled in Students (e.g. "5" vs "P5" matters). The last class on this list is treated as your graduating class: promoting from it marks a student Graduated instead of moving them to a new class.

          

          
        

        

          
Promote Students to Next Class (Year-End)

          
Run this once, after closing your final term of the year. Every active student moves up one class following the Promotion Path above. Anyone already in the last class on that list is marked Graduated — they stay fully in the database (fees, payments, academic history all intact) but drop off the active Students list by default, viewable anytime under Students → "Graduated".

          
          

        

        

          
Danger zone

          
Erases every student, payment and setting on this device. Export a backup first if you're not sure.
